'''''Agave angustifolia''''' ('''Caribbean agave'''{{citation needed|date=October 2023}}) is a [[species]] of [[agave]] [[plant]] which is native to [[Mexico]] and [[Central America]].<ref name="POWO">{{cite web|url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:327760-2 |title=''Agave angustifolia'' Haw. |date=2023 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Royal Botanical Gardens, Kew |access-date=1 August 2023}}</ref> It is used to make [[mezcal]] and also as an [[ornamental plant]]. The cultivar 'Marginata' that white margins on the leaves is a popular variety cultivated in botanical gardens and backyards. It is very closely related to blue agave [[Blue agave|''Agave tequilana'']], but is used to make the distilled alcoholic beverage [[mezcal]] instead of [[tequila]],<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.mezcalreviews.com/filter-by/maguey/ | title=Maguey }}</ref> and is the predominant agave species grown in the Mexican state of [[Oaxaca]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://mezcalphd.com/2018/11/tequila-vs-mezcal/ | title=Tequila vs. Mezcal - Mezcal PhD | date=25 November 2018 }}</ref>
